notes: 'will cause my wrath toward them to rest' is one discontinuous unit for the hiphil, headed on the complement verb (rules 44, 25).
The temporal infinitive clause divides as rule 52 requires: 'when' on בְּ, the verb on the infinitive, the subject pronoun on its suffix (rule 18).
The opening waw takes the connective 'Thus' the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
